facts.fact: 叙述者的哥哥 Ishko 已失踪十个月，她把他的话当作安慰反复播放。
facts.anchor: Ten months and no sighting of Ishko.

facts.fact: Ishko 创办的环保组织 GLEE 对他的下落保持缄默，社交账号只发「暂停」「重组」。
facts.anchor: Ishko’s eco organization, Great Lakes Environmental Ethics (GLEE), has remained noncommittal about his fate and their future.

facts.fact: 叙述者的西班牙猎犬叫 Wingnut，她在花园里发现了一个四趾的巨大脚印，像成年公狼的足迹。
facts.anchor: Wingnut, my spaniel, runs back and forth, back and forth at the verge, sniffing wildly, like a runner doing wind sprints.

facts.fact: 狼的右前腿上有块伤疤，形状像弯盘或孩子的纸月亮——叙述者把它当作希望的预兆。
facts.anchor: A scar shaped like a curved dish or child’s paper moon.

facts.fact: Ishko 用演讲和公开信抨击「开采与压裂换取持续繁荣」的计划，揭露矿业公司的骗局。
facts.anchor: In letter after letter, speech after speech, he called “extract and frack for continued prosperity” a failed plan.

facts.fact: 新闻把 Ishko 塑造成「环境媒体宠儿自毁」，还谣传他在德卢斯港跳船溺亡。
facts.anchor: “Environmental Media Darling Self-Destructs” was the Fox News headline.

facts.fact: 爱犬 Wingnut 去世，叙述者用烟熏仪式净化后埋葬她，在坟边留下食物与木雕。
facts.anchor: After I smudge Wingnut and bury her, I leave small symbols at the mound of earth—food and a carving.

facts.fact: 叙述者划船沿河追寻线索，终于在一根芦苇上发现一小片她认识的蓝色美利奴羊毛布料。
facts.anchor: One reed is draped in a tatter of blue merino fabric I recognize.
